evidence.quote: We propose a $32 million class fund distributed automatically, with a separate fee and expense request subject to court approval.
Term sheet: class fund $32,000,000; attorneys' fees $6,000,000; clear sailing no;
We can offer a $27 million class fund plus up to $5 million in court-approved fees and expenses, without clear sailing.
we can accept your $5 million fee figure, subject to court approval, if Brightline increases the class fund to $30 million.

summary: Plaintiffs first raised fees in their opening public settlement proposals, and fee amounts were negotiated alongside class relief before the final $29 million fund was accepted. There is an explicit linkage where Ostrander Bell conditioned acceptance of Brightline’s $5 million fee figure on an increased class fund. The transcript does not show plaintiff self-interest overriding class recovery, defense leveraging fee interests, reverse-auction tactics, or a misleading declaration.
